title: Pointwise supported-cone test for the right-adjoint open unit
statement: Let f:X\to Y be a morphism of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let V\subseteq Y be quasi-compact open, and U=f^{-1}(V). In the shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-direct-image], let a be right adjoint to the quasi-coherent lift of Rf_*, supplied with its preservation-of-quasi-coherence proof. Supply the derived open restriction adjunction j^*\dashv Rj_* [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps] and a proof that Rj_*j^* preserves quasi-coherent objects. For each K\in D_QCoh(Y) there exists Q\in D_QCoh(Y) such that j^*Q is zero, Q is bounded below whenever K is, and j_U^*a(K\to Rj_*j^*K) is an isomorphism if and only if j_U^*a(Q) is zero. The map is the supplied adjunction unit, lifted to the quasi-coherent category.

proof.text: For a given quasi-coherent derived object K, use [lem-sc-open-restriction-support-triangle] to obtain a distinguished triangle for its constructed open adjunction, with quasi-coherent cone Q, zero cohomology stalks on V, and a lower bound on Q whenever K has a lower bound. Exact restriction commutes with homology; restriction has zero cohomology precisely when those stalks are zero. The latter equivalence is proved here by the open stalk isomorphisms, sheaf section extensionality, and DerivedCategory.isIso_iff. The proved restriction_zero_iff_stalks helper is public so the support-extension module imports and reuses it.

For the constructed adjunction ra and the supplied adjOpen, form their leftAdjointUniq isomorphism. Applying Rj_* to its component gives an automorphism e of the second vertex. The unit uniqueness equation is ra.unit.app K composed with e.hom = adjOpen.unit.app K. Replace the second triangle arrow by e.inv composed with the original second arrow. Triangle.isoMk transports distinguishedness, preserving the same Q and its bound.

Specialize [lem-pc-supported-qcoh-triangulated] to the whole scheme to give the triangulated quasi-coherent categories. The derived direct image is exact by [lem-pc-right-derived-functor-triangulated], and its full-subcategory lift is exact. Mathlib Adjunction.rightAdjointCommShift and commShift_of_leftAdjoint construct the compatible shifts on a; Adjunction.isTriangulated_rightAdjoint then gives its exactness. Apply a, the exact inclusion, and exact restriction to U to the transported full-subcategory triangle. Mathlib Triangle.isZero₃_iff_isIso₁ gives precisely the pointwise test.

proof_origin.note: Formalization of the indicated part of the Stacks proof, using the existing support-triangle statement and Mathlib triangle/adjunction APIs. Returned-delivery repair: expose the existing restriction_zero_iff_stalks helper for reuse without changing its binders or proposition.

theorem rightAdjoint_open_unit_cone_test
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (V : Y.Opens) (hV : IsCompact (V : Set Y))
    (U : X.Opens) (_hU : U = f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (hpush : ∀ K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj K.obj))
    (a : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (adj : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f) hpush ⊣ a)
    (adjOpen : (schemeOpenRestriction Y V).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage
          V.ι)
    (hopen : ∀ K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y,
      schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage V.ι).obj
          ((schemeOpenRestriction Y V).mapDerivedCategory.obj K.obj)))
    (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) :
    ∃ Q : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y,
      IsZero ((schemeOpenRestriction Y V).mapDerivedCategory.obj Q.obj) ∧
      ((∃ n : ℤ, K.obj.IsGE n) → ∃ n : ℤ, Q.obj.IsGE n) ∧
      (IsIso ((schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategory.map
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι.map (a.map (ObjectProperty.homMk (X := K)
        (Y := ⟨(schemeDerivedDirectImage V.ι).obj
          ((schemeOpenRestriction Y V).mapDerivedCategory.obj K.obj), hopen K⟩)
        (adjOpen.unit.app K.obj))))) ↔
        IsZero ((schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategory.obj (a.obj Q).obj))
